tools.do_not_use_when: Do not cite snippets as facts; capture the original source first
tools.use_when: Find public source leads for a bounded research query

tools.do_not_use_when: No credentials, login, internal addresses or executable downloads
tools.use_when: Capture an authorized public URL as a tainted evidence snapshot

tools.do_not_use_when: Do not promote past model output to verified knowledge or bypass source ACL
tools.use_when: Retrieve reviewed knowledge with product, phase and applicability constraints

tools.do_not_use_when: Attachment existence is not a passing test; never fill missing actual values
tools.use_when: Inspect spec/case/sample/build/run evidence and configuration gaps

tools.do_not_use_when: Does not approve Gate, close Issue or replace the action's current checks
tools.use_when: Evaluate current prerequisites for a named action at an exact version

tools.do_not_use_when: Never change baseline/commitment or reserve capacity; missing inputs stay explicit
tools.use_when: Compute a proposed task graph using calendar/capacity input snapshots

tools.do_not_use_when: Does not execute ECN or convert evidence links into execution dependencies
tools.use_when: Trace versioned spec/BOM/configuration/test/plan relations for a proposed change

tools.do_not_use_when: Do not publish definitions, confirm unknown criteria or call a hidden second model
tools.use_when: Validate and package the model's structured definition draft into a Finding

tools.do_not_use_when: Do not create Project/Task/Baseline or treat unconfirmed estimates as commitments
tools.use_when: Validate the supplied plan draft, sources and scenario for a plan Finding

tools.do_not_use_when: Do not copy old results as new configuration passes or invent test results
tools.use_when: Package a typed test-plan diff for new requirements as a Finding

tools.do_not_use_when: Do not parse new uploads, create drafts, confirm mappings or synthesize cell values
tools.use_when: Read original values and mapping state from an already authorized import batch

tools.do_not_use_when: Customer confirmation does not replace internal ECN approval; do not apply
tools.use_when: Package the model's cross-domain change and revalidation actions as a Finding

tools.do_not_use_when: Do not mark hypotheses proven, actions completed or effectiveness verified
tools.use_when: Package failure evidence, root-cause hypotheses and effectiveness plan as a CAPA Finding

tools.do_not_use_when: Generating or sending a package is not acceptance; never impersonate the receiver
tools.use_when: Read handoff gaps or propose a versioned package with sender/receiver and evidence
